The '''2024–25 Eredivisie''' was the 69th season of [[Eredivisie]], the premier football competition in the [[Netherlands]]. It began on 9 August 2024 and concluded on 1 June 2025.<ref>{{cite news|url=https://eredivisie.eu/news/matchday-calendar-eredivisie-football-season-2024-25-determined/|title=Matchday calendar eredivisie football season 2024/'25 determined|date=19 January 2024|website=Eredivisie}}</ref>

[[PSV Eindhoven]], who entered the last 5 weeks of the season 9 points behind [[AFC Ajax|Ajax]], entered the last week ahead thanks to Ajax's point losses and defeated [[Sparta Rotterdam|Sparta]] 3–1 in the last match of the league on May 18, 2025 and completed the league as champions for the 26th time.

==Changes==

{| class="wikitable"
|-
! {{increase}} from [[2023–24 Eerste Divisie]] !! {{decrease}} to [[2024–25 Eerste Divisie]] 
|-
| [[Willem II Tilburg|Willem II]] (promoted after a two season absence)<br />[[FC Groningen|Groningen]] (promoted after a single season absence)<br />[[NAC Breda]] (Play-offs, promoted after a five season absence)
| [[Excelsior Rotterdam|Excelsior]] (Play-offs, relegated after two seasons in top flight)<br />[[FC Volendam|Volendam]] (relegated after two seasons in top flight)<br />[[SBV Vitesse|Vitesse]] (relegated after 35 seasons in top flight)
|}

This was the last season with artificial turf being legal. Since this season there are no clubs anymore that play on [[artificial turf]], all clubs play on [[lawn|natural grass]] or [[hybrid grass]]. As per next season, natural/hybrid grass on the home ground stadium pitch, is obliged in the Eredivisie. <ref>{{cite news|url= https://nos.nl/artikel/2477841-kunstgras-in-de-ban-eredivisieclubs-vanaf-2025-2026-verplicht-op-natuurgras |title= Kunstgras in de ban: eredivisieclubs vanaf 2025/2026 verplicht op natuurgras|trans-title= Artificial turf banned: Eredivisie clubs required to play on natural grass from 2025/2026 |language=Dutch|publisher=nos.nl|date=5 June 2023|access-date=29 January 2025}}</ref>
